nodes.name: Webhook - Analyst Feedback
nodes.notes: Analyst feedback via form/email. Validates token, forwards to triage-api POST /feedback. No autonomous containment - contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

nodes.name: Validate Token & Verdict
nodes.notes: Real token validation against $env secret (exact match, reject missing/wrong, never log). Validates verdict allow-list. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed - no host isolation/user disable/containment. No destructive, no autonomous, no secrets.

parameters.formDescription: Submit verdict for alert. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed (human approval required).

nodes.name: Form - Feedback
nodes.notes: Human approval form. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed. No autonomous response.

nodes.name: HTTP - POST Feedback to API
nodes.notes: POST feedback to triage-api. Token from env credential $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN || $env.N8N_CALLBACK_TOKEN. Verdict allow-list enforced. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed. No autonomous containment.

nodes.name: Switch - Contain Requested?
nodes.notes: If contain_requested, create approval-required ticket only. No containment action is executed - no host isolation, no user disable. Human approval required.

parameters.subject: ={{ '[SOC][CONTAINMENT REQUEST - APPROVAL REQUIRED] Alert ' + ($json.alert_id || $json.body && $json.body.alert_id || 'unknown') }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Containment requested for alert ' + ($json.alert_id || 'unknown') + '

IMPORTANT: contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed. No host isolation, no user disable, no autonomous action. Human approval required via ticketing system.

Verdict: ' + $json.verdict + '
Notes: ' + ($json.notes || '') + '
Actor: ' + ($json.actor || '') }}

nodes.name: Email - Containment Approval Request
nodes.notes: Approval-required containment request. No containment action executed. Human approval only. No autonomous.

parameters.responseData: ={{ { "status": "feedback_received", "alert_id": $json.alert_id, "verdict": $json.verdict, "note": "contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed" } }}

meta.description: Phase 2B feedback workflow FIXED: real token validation ($env secret exact match, reject missing/wrong, never log, never hardcode), verdict allow-list, POST to /api/v1/alerts/{id}/feedback, contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed (no host isolation, no user disable, no autonomous containment). Human approval only. No secrets, no full_log, no destructive.
